```yaml
name: Publish Remote Config

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 5 * * *' # Daily at 5 AM UTC

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Ruff checks
      run: uvx ruff check --select I .

    - name: Run Ruff formatting check
      run: uvx ruff format --check .

    - name: Run Pyright
      run: uv run pyright .

    - name: Run tests
      run: uv run python3 -m pytest --benchmark-quiet -q .

    - name: Rename remote_model_list to remote_config
      run: sed -i 's/remote_model_list/remote_config/g' kiln/config.py

    - name: Serialize remote_config
      run: python -c "import json; import kiln.config; print(json.dumps(kiln.config.remote_config))" > remote_config.json

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add kiln/config.py remote_config.json
        git commit -m "chore: rename remote_model_list to remote_config and serialize config"

    - name: Push changes
      uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.7.0
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        branch: main

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./docs
        publish_branch: gh-pages
        force_orphan: true
```
